grammar.summary: 本课学习将来时 will 表预言与 harbor 场景表达。

points.title: will 表预言
points.explanation: 对未来的预判：We'll meet him tomorrow. / He will sail across the Atlantic. 否定 won't，疑问 Will he...?

examples.en: Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock.
examples.cn: Alison 船长将于八点出发。

points.title: so that / enough...to（初步接触）
points.explanation: We are proud of him.（be proud of 表自豪）介词固定搭配。

examples.en: He will take part in an important race.
examples.cn: 他将参加一场重要比赛。
